translations.text: He will take his name from my own name; he will make a law concerning women, [reaching] from the beautiful, vast Sea of Wight [the English Channel]. He will be a sage of learning [?] (co cendanim); [?] (rosia let form) good speech [?] (dechindscne); he will [?] (arcenfa) a very great law. [?] (Birar) who will take the sovereignty of Tara from Fínnachta, over Tara a strength that will not [?] rise; thirty years in the abbacy for him, for Adomnán, wonderful in great tidings.
